title: Apple : Plans Subscription Service for Games -- Cheddar | MarketScreener
text:
--Apple Inc. (AAPL) is planning a subscription service for games, Cheddar reported Monday, citing five people familiar with the matter.
--The Netflix-like service would allow customers to pay a subscription fee for access to a bundle of titles, according to the report.
--It is unclear how much subscriptions would cost or what titles would be on offer, the report said, adding that Apple began privately discussing a subscription service with game developers in the second half of 2018.
--An Apple spokesperson declined to comment, Cheddar reported.
Full story at https://cheddar.com/videos/apple-plans-gaming-subscription-service-sources
